display_name: LoRa W24 四分量复数方向恢复训练
description: Add four within-component angular losses to the matched whole-packet peer-spectral recipe.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA performance research goal.

code.commit: Resolved Git HEAD of the recorded branch at publication
code.environment: N607 single admissible CUDA card, BF16 convolution on supported devices and FP32 masked attention; CPU truth-last.
code.cwd: Immutable release for GPU fitting; original W24 E104 release for post-freeze CPU smoke, prediction and scoring.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Original registered U_s practical trace bank and deterministic 4000 per receiver fit plus 500 independent held; frozen 300 same-ID source V panel.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Reuse VALIDATED_ONCE lora_full_packets_v1 registered V order and true E104.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only isolated fitting, frozen received-only evaluation, source labels joined only by the independent source scorer.

checkpoint.initialization: Freeze the same Practical source-only parent. Initialize the 25,732-parameter head from the same original random seed as the frozen peer reference.

sources.role: Frozen original 24000-step additive half restoration, including edges.
Independent matched 48000-step reference scored with the identical grouped readout.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Matched simulated source IQ, native W24 center projection, measured phase and unchanged frozen parent.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Same legal LoRa source role and paired additive reference, no F, TX, V or target during fit.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze the prescribed terminal 48000-step checkpoint. Source metrics diagnose. On a valid freeze the registered Full run proceeds regardless of source accuracy.

execution.gpu_policy: One available GPU under current shared training cap, priority 7,0,3,2,6,5. After freeze two-thread CPU inference, two replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Mismatched source/weight bindings, nonfinite source check/training, baseline parity or blind closure/scorer error. Preserve existing healthy owner tasks and partial outputs.

dimensions: native Full; 300 same source V packets; seven views; five readouts; five source receivers

rows.method: Matched source-only peer-spectral with four orthogonal complex direction losses
rows.seed_notes: New source fit seed 2026112991; registered V panel and Full draw; independent E104 seed 2026092702.
rows.budget_ref: Single seed. 48000 AdamW steps; batch 16 including 2 clean identity rows. Frozen 24k Practical parent, 20000 fit/500 held source U packets.

notes: Identical PeerSpectralDirection structure, random initialization and AdamW trajectory length as the matched peer reference.
Add 0.50 times average component angle loss on the cross-chirp center proposal. Tracker phase is measured from observed center IQ.
Both frozen alternatives use identical grouped deployment: use the four parent component norms and preserve original parent native edges.
The Full formal test is preregistered separately and waits for the legal terminal checkpoint, without source score selection.
